name: field
title: Field
description: Form controls that need a label, help text, and error.
docs:
## Installation ```install npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/field ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { useId } from "react"; import { Field, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from "@/components/cadence/field"; import { Input } from "@/components/cadence/input"; export function CompanyField() { const id = useId(); return ( Company Appears on the invoice header. ); } ``` ## Orientation Vertical stacks a label above its control. Horizontal keeps a compact control beside its label. These fixed instances do not change each other or the responsive example. ```tsx "use client"; import { useId } from "react"; import { Field, FieldGroup, FieldLabel } from "@/components/cadence/field"; import { Input } from "@/components/cadence/input"; export function FieldOrientations() { const id = useId(); return ( Company Currency ); } ``` ## Responsive layout `responsive` follows the width of its FieldGroup container, not the viewport. It stays vertical in a narrow panel and changes to a row at the `md` container threshold (28rem). Resize the page to see the wide group change while the narrow group remains vertical. ```tsx "use client"; import { useId } from "react"; import { Field, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldGroup, FieldLabel } from "@/components/cadence/field"; import { Input } from "@/components/cadence/input"; export function ResponsiveFields() { const id = useId(); return (
Company Uses the available group width. Project
); } ``` ## An error, from the caller The caller supplies `data-invalid`, `aria-invalid`, messages and description IDs; Field does no validation. This action simulates an application updating its supplied error without replacing the input or its draft. Duplicate messages collapse into one list entry; no messages means no error node. ```tsx "use client"; import { useId, useState } from "react"; import { Button } from "@/components/cadence/button"; import { Field, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/cadence/field"; import { Input } from "@/components/cadence/input"; export function CallerError() { const id = useId(); const [invalid, setInvalid] = useState(true); return (
VAT number Use the number on your invoice.
); } ``` ## A set, a legend, and a divider Use FieldSet and FieldLegend for related controls. The first legend uses the default heading size and the second uses `variant="label"`. FieldSeparator can show a centred word or a plain rule; it does not decide which input is required. ```tsx "use client"; import { useId } from "react"; import { Field, FieldGroup, FieldLabel, FieldLegend, FieldSeparator, FieldSet } from "@/components/cadence/field"; import { Input } from "@/components/cadence/input"; export function BillingFields() { const id = useId(); return (
Billing details Company or Individual name
Invoice contact Email
); } ``` ## A choice card A wrapping FieldLabel supplies the card border and a real label association. The checkbox owns checked state; FieldTitle and FieldDescription provide its name and description. Click the card or use Space on the checkbox. The composed Checkbox keeps its own motion contract and inherits the page setting. ```tsx "use client"; import { useId } from "react"; import { Checkbox } from "@/components/cadence/checkbox"; import { Field, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldGroup, FieldLabel, FieldTitle } from "@/components/cadence/field"; export function ChoiceCard() { const id = useId(); return ( Team plan Unlimited projects for your team. ); } ``` ## When to use - Any control that needs a visible label plus a line of help: text, select, checkbox group, radio group, a segmented choice. - A form where the error has to sit next to the control it belongs to, not in a summary at the top. - A choice card — a `Field` that contains a whole control card — where the label is the surface and the checked state is the selection. ## When not to use - A single input with no label and no help. Do not wrap it; `input` already carries its own border and focus ring. - A validation module. `Field` renders messages; it never produces them (P11). - A toolbar of loose controls. Group those with `button-group`, which has no label semantics to offer. ## API | Part | Props | Notes | | ------------------ | ---------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | | `Field` | `orientation`, native props | `vertical \| horizontal \| responsive`; `role="group"`, `data-orientation`. | | `FieldLabel` | `Label` props | A real `label`; click focuses the control. | | `FieldTitle` | native div props | Label-weight text that is not tied to a control. | | `FieldDescription` | native props for `p` | Muted help text, balanced in horizontal orientation. | | `FieldError` | `errors`, native div props | `errors`: `{ message?: string }[]`. `role="alert"`, `null` when empty. | | `FieldGroup` | native div props | Container query root; vertical rhythm between fields. | | `FieldContent` | native div props | Control plus description/error stack. | | `FieldSet` | native props for `fieldset` | Groups related fields; pairs with `FieldLegend`. | | `FieldLegend` | `variant` | `legend \| label` sizes the legend text. | | `FieldSeparator` | `children` | Rule with optional centred text; exposes `data-content`. | `data-slot` values: `field`, `field-label`, `field-description`, `field-error`, `field-group`, `field-content`, `field-set`, `field-legend`, `field-separator`, `field-separator-content`. ## Motion contract No motion (T0). A field never animates — not on mount, not when the error appears. The error is the one thing the user must read immediately; fading or sliding it in delays the only information that matters, and it moves the control the user's cursor is in. | Phase | Properties | Token | Interruptible | | ------- | ---------- | ----- | ------------- | | – | none | – | – | | reduced | none | – | – | | none | none | – | – | `data-[invalid=true]` recolours the field's text on the destructive token. That is a colour change, not a motion, and it is never the only signal. ## Accessibility - `FieldLabel` is a `label`, so clicking it focuses the control it names. Always pass `htmlFor` matching the control's `id`; a `FieldTitle` is not a substitute. - An error is `role="alert"`: it is announced when it appears. Point the control at it with `aria-describedby` so the message is also part of the control's description. - `aria-invalid` on the control is what makes the state machine-readable; the destructive colour is the sighted half of the same signal. - A horizontal field puts the label after the content in source order when the content holds the control. Keep the DOM order label → control for a simple pair. ## Validation and data ownership P11 draws the line: the component renders state, you decide state. | `Field` does | You do | | ------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | | Renders the message it is given (`children` or `errors`) | Deciding what is invalid (required, format, async checks) | | Marks the error `role="alert"` | Wiring `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby` on the control | | Colours the field when `data-invalid` / `aria-invalid` | Form state, submit, retry, focus management | | Shows a description and an error at once | Writing the copy and the ids | There is no `schema`, `resolver`, `validate`, or `rules` prop, and no validation library is imported. `FieldError` accepts messages, not rules: the decision that a value is wrong, and the copy that says so, stay in your form code. ## Responsiveness and performance FieldGroup establishes a named container. Responsive orientation switches from column to row at its md container query; explicit vertical and horizontal orientations remain caller-selected. Labels, error text and controls must fit the available width. T0 adds no authored animation runtime or interpolation. This wrapper renders HTML/CSS; interactive children and application handlers still need their own client code. Composed controls retain their own dependencies and motion contracts. Server-rendered markup does not imply that every interaction works without JavaScript. The registry enforces a 4 KiB gzip budget for this item's own shipped source; dependencies and application bundles are measured separately. ## Notes for AI - Do not add an `error` prop to `Input`; put the message in `FieldError` and point `aria-describedby` at it. - Use `FieldGroup` as the container, not a `space-y-*` div: the responsive orientation depends on being inside a container query root. - `FieldError` returns `null` when it has no content, so it is safe to keep mounted.
